resources.string: Glaukopis cannot start on this device yet

Glaukopis is shown by Android System WebView, a part of Android that is updated as an app is. This device has version %1$d of it, and Glaukopis needs version %2$d or later.\n\nUpdate Android System WebView in the app store of the device. On some devices it is Chrome that is to be updated. Then open Glaukopis again.

Glaukopis is shown by Android System WebView, a part of Android that is updated as an app is. This device has none that can be used.\n\nInstall Android System WebView from the app store of the device, or turn it on among the apps in the settings. Then open Glaukopis again.
